SECURITY (M2 EU-pin gap, Bedrock BYOK): BedrockCredential.region (tenant-supplied via PUT /admin/provider-keys/bedrock) drives the physical dial endpoint bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com, DECOUPLED from the catalog region tag residency-policy filters on. An EU-pinned tenant with a us-east-1 Bedrock cred has its PROMPT sent to a US endpoint (payload transit = the breach) even if AWS then rejects the eu.-profile invocation. Vertex avoided this (fixed prefix→location map). Options: (a) pre-dial structural guard validating cred region vs candidate catalog-region prefix [RECOMMENDED, mirrors vertex], (b) live-AWS ValidationException test, (c) signed RISK-ACCEPTED. ESCALATED to Tin 2026-07-13 — do NOT treat M10/EU-pin as closed for Bedrock until resolved.

Fix = validate BedrockCredential.region vs tenants.residency_region at BYOK registration for pinned tenants. Candidate residency-policy follow-on.
